name: streamer-chat-tts-hub
description: Hub local de chat de streaming con TTS (fase 1: Twitch). Monorepo backend + frontend orquestado con PM2.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix viewer install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix viewer install
scripts.start: node scripts/docker-melo.mjs up && node scripts/cloudflare-tunnel.mjs up && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.stop: pm2 stop ecosystem.config.js && node scripts/docker-melo.mjs stop && node scripts/cloudflare-tunnel.mjs stop
scripts.down: pm2 delete ecosystem.config.js && node scripts/docker-melo.mjs down && node scripts/cloudflare-tunnel.mjs stop
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix viewer run lint
